description:
Read a whole Kromatic page when an excerpt is not enough: a method's steps, thresholds, costs, examples and AI prompts, a blog post, a lesson, or what a template contains. Pass the id from list_resources or the document_external_key from search_resources.

Returns the title, the kromatic.com url, the full text and metadata. Templates are described and their files named, but never linked. It never triggers a sign-in screen: if part of an item is withheld, has_access is false and access says what is needed, "requires_sign_in" (read it again after the user has signed in; it may then need a purchase) or "requires_purchase", with an access_note giving the kromatic.com page.

Next: answer from the text and cite the url. Long pages come in parts: pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null. For a template's files, call download_resource.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous read of this item, to get the next part.
cursor.title: Cursor

id.description: An item id from list_resources or a document_external_key from search_resources; they are the same kind of id. Copy it exactly.
id.title: Id

resource_type.description: Needed with slug: the item's type as listed (templates are "Download"). Book Section = a method page of The Real Startup Book. Download = a template or worksheet; Download File = one file inside it. Tool = the full guide text for one of Kromatic's interactive web apps (e.g. Experiment Calculator, Startup Poker); Tools / Games = the website's link entry for the same apps, with less text. Prefer Tool when you want content.
resource_type.title: Resource Type

slug.description: Alternative to id: the item's slug, together with resource_type, e.g. slug "pivot-or-persevere-template" with resource_type "Download" for a template. Prefer the id when you have one.
slug.title: Slug

name: read_resource
title: Read resource
